items: 【Relieve Back Pain & Sit Longer Comfortably】 Designed to support your lower back and spine, this recliner lumbar pillow helps reduce pressure and discomfort during long sitting sessions—perfect for elderly, recovery, or daily relaxation.

【Large Ergonomic Support Design】 Wider and thicker than standard cushions, it fully supports your waist and lower back, fitting the natural curve of your body for better posture. It is especially suitable for the elderly who need to lean and rest for a long time, making every lean safe and comfortable

【Premium Memory Foam】 High-density memory foam adapts to your body while maintaining support, helping improve posture and reduce fatigue.The cushion is OEKO-TEX Certificated with no odor. The memory foam and plush fabric cover are all made of safe material.

【Adjustable Strap Design】 Upgraded straps keep the cushion securely attached to your recliner, so it won’t slip when you move.Ideal for watching TV, reading, resting, or recovering—turn any chair into a comfortable support system.

【Breathable & Removable Cover】 This backrest cushion is equipped with a detachable and machine-washable cover, which ensures good air circulation and keeps your back cool and comfortable at all times.【NOTICE】Your back cushion arrives compressed, but set up only takes 4 easy steps: open your package, unroll the cushion, cut the plastic, then allow 24-48 hours to expand
